title: FAQ Content & Internal Link Optimization for AI Resume Keywords
hypothesis: Adding structured FAQ content schema and 5 internal contextual links from high-authority blog posts will improve rankings for core AI resume keywords.
changes_made: Added 6 structured FAQ items with Schema markup
Created 5 internal links from /blog/ai-recruitment with descriptive anchors
notes: Position jumped from 31 to 14 within 6 weeks. FAQ snippet triggered on 4 terms.

title: Meta Title Restructuring for Intent Alignment
hypothesis: Rewriting meta title to explicitly include 'Free Instant Scan & Score' will increase CTR and search ranking.
changes_made: Changed title from 'ATS Checker | TalentFlow AI' to 'Free ATS Resume Checker - Instant AI Resume Score (2026)'
notes: Recovered position from 36 to 16. Higher CTR signaled user relevance to search engine.

title: Shortened Keyword-Stuffed Title Tag
hypothesis: Shortening the title tag to a single branded term will improve brand authority.
changes_made: Replaced 'AI CV Parser Tool - Parse Resumes Online' with 'TalentFlow Parser'
notes: Ranking dropped by 7 positions. Removing relevant keyword from title reduced relevance signal. Learned to retain core keyword in titles.

title: Comprehensive Content Expansion to 2,500 Words
hypothesis: Expanding content length from 800 to 2,500 words with expert quotes will improve semantic topic authority.
changes_made: Added 1,700 words of technical deep dive content
notes: Ranking improved by 22 positions. Extended content reduced bounce rate by 24%.

title: Authoritative Data Citation & Infographic Outreach

notes: Earned 14 new editorial backlinks and 6 brand citations. Improved position from 21 to 15.
